install: sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' ~/.bashrc 2>/dev/null || true && (command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1 || { curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash && export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH" && (grep -qxF 'export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"' ~/.bashrc || echo 'export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"' >> ~/.bashrc); }) && (command -v bunx >/dev/null 2>&1 || { mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin" && ln -sfn "$(command -v bun)" "$HOME/.local/bin/bunx" && export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" && (grep -qxF 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"' ~/.bashrc || echo 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"' >> ~/.bashrc); }) && bun install --frozen-lockfile
